text: Imperial riddles unlock hints at 60 s and 120 s, are solved by flying to the hidden answer, and time out.
Scavenger hunts hide tokens that only appear up close, pulse warmer or colder, and fail when time runs out.
Story dialogue types out beside the Emperor's portrait, advances on F or click, and can be skipped.
The quest log shows the story so far and the current objective, and sets a waypoint the HUD follows.
